name: Argo-ui Seontaeg
source: Argo heads to his favorite place, STYX, to spend one last night in the fallen city. A long night. It’s at this place that Argo begins to open up about his past... How will Argo’s last night end?
translation: 阿尔戈来到最喜欢的地方STYX，准备在这座堕落的城市度过最后一夜。那将是一个漫长的夜晚。就在这里，阿尔戈开始敞开心扉，讲述自己的过去……他的最后一夜，将如何结束？
